verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships its own AI agent (Rudder AI in Slack), so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question for this product. The evidence, however, documents only the opposite role: an official RudderStack MCP server consumed by external clients like Claude, Cursor and Codex. That server-side capability does not transfer to this story, and nothing shows RudderStack or Rudder AI acting as an MCP client.
